pages.title: Fire a Vessel
pages.text: Craft an Unfired Clay Bucket from three Clay Balls, then fire it in a furnace or on a campfire. The unfired item cannot carry fluid.

pages.title: Water and Tannin
pages.text: A fired Clay Bucket carries water or Tannin Solution from source fluid blocks and barrel transfers. It cannot collect lava. Barrel withdrawal requires a full 1000 mB. Empty vessels can be refilled.

pages.title: Crafting Remainders
pages.text: Water Clay Buckets supply dough and plaster recipes and return empty Clay Buckets. Metal Tannin Solution Buckets also transfer barrel fluid. Sealed barrels prevent these transfers until opened.
